intent: Descriptive bounded GPU comparison of eager and compiled CQL executions; no selection or claim the retained strict parity gate passed.
selection_rule: first observations in trajectory order, including only the first horizon observations per trajectory
batch_rule: PCG64 offline_batches sampler with replacement; identical rows in both executions
state_rule: separate paths advance from identical initialized states; compare per-leaf state, actor action, and update metric differences
common_state_rule: compare eager and jitted Bellman target calculations at the same eager state, RNG, and minibatch each update
counter_rng_rule: require exact counters and RNG values each update
finite_rule: report nonfinite values and fail diagnostic if encountered
interpretation: Raw descriptive differences only; no post-observation equivalence threshold. Previously failed strict parity remains failed.
